position_overview: About the Role We are seeking an accomplished Real Estate Administration Support Manager to join our fast-growing, US-based real estate team. As a senior leader with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in US real estate support, you will oversee the entire administrative lifecycle-including listing coordination, transaction management, CRM oversight, documentation, compliance, and optimization of operational processes. This is not an entry-level or junior position. We require a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can independently drive multiple transactions, support both agents and executive leadership, and ensure seamless day-to-day operations with minimal supervision. Key Responsibilities - Manage property listings from initial setup to successful post-closing - Coordinate listing documentation, MLS uploads, and ongoing listing updates - Prepare contracts, disclosures, and essential transaction documents - Support buyers, sellers, agents, lenders, title companies, and attorneys throughout transactions - Track and monitor transaction timelines to meet all deadlines - Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across multiple CRM systems - Oversee client databases and pipeline reporting - Organize appointments, inspections, appraisals, and closings - Prepare Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) support documents as needed - Handle email and calendar management for agents and leadership - Ensure compliance with all brokerage and state documentation requirements - Generate reports and provide operational assistance to company leadership - Identify and implement improvements to administrative processes and workflow efficiency Essential Requirements - Minimum 5 years of recent experience supporting a US-based real estate business - Thorough understanding of the complete US real estate transaction process - Extensive expertise in managing property listings and end-to-end transaction coordination - Proven track record supporting real estate agents, brokers, or teams - Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills - Self-starter capable of working independently with minimal supervision - Strong problem-solving, multitasking, and time management skills - Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while juggling multiple transactions Experience with US Real Estate Platforms & CRMs Signifi

As a senior leader with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in US real estate support, you will oversee the entire administrative lifecycle-including listing coordination, transaction management, CRM oversight, documentation, compliance, and optimization of operational processes. This is not an entry-level or junior position. We require a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can independently drive multiple transactions, support both agents and executive leadership, and ensure seamless day-to-day operations with minimal supervision. Support buyers, sellers, agents, lenders, title companies, and attorneys throughout transactions - Track and monitor transaction timelines to meet all deadlines - Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across multiple CRM systems - Ensure compliance with all brokerage and state documentation requirements - Generate reports and provide operational assistance to company leadership - Identify and implement improvements to administrative processes and workflow efficiency Essential Requirements - Minimum 5 years of recent experience supporting a US-based real estate business - Thorough understanding of the complete US real estate transaction process - Extensive expertise in managing property listings and end-to-end transaction coordination - Proven track record supporting real estate agents, brokers, or teams - Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills - Self-starter capable of working independently with minimal supervision - Strong problem-solving, multitasking, and time management skills - Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while juggling multiple transactions Experience with US Real Estate Platforms & CRMs Significant hands-on experience with several of the following is highly preferred: - MLS systems - Follow Up Boss - KVCore - Salesforce - BoomTown - Sierra Interactive - Chime CRM - Lofty - Zillow Premier Agent - Dotloop - SkySlope - DocuSign / DocuSign Rooms - TransactionDesk - ShowingTime - ZipForms - Google Workspace - Microsoft Office 365 Nice to Have - Experience supporting high-volume real estate teams - Familiarity with multiple US state real estate transaction processes - Demonstrated success in creating workflows and improving processes - Previous leadership or senior-level administrative support experience What We Offer - Permanent Work From Home - Work directly with a US-based client - Full-time EST schedule - Competitive salary based on experience - Long-term career opportunity - Supportive and collaborative team environment If you are a seasoned US Real Estate professional who excels in transaction management, agent support, and operational excellence, we want to hear from you. Apply today and play a pivotal role in our expanding US-based team.
